## Checklist
- [ ] End-to-end tested, scoped to this PR (drove the affected flow on the running app, not just tests/typecheck)
- [ ] Unnecessary/verbose dev logs and debug logging removed
- [ ] Leftover comments, commented-out code, and TODO droppings removed
- [ ] Goal achieved — the PR does what the Problem section says, fully, or the gap is stated above
- [ ] Tests added/updated for behavior changes; full suite green
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` files anywhere in the diff or new history
- [ ] Diff contains only changes related to this PR's stated goal — nothing unrelated rode along
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed (and for harness cycles: the cycle log rides in this PR)
- [ ] Self-reviewed the full diff line-by-line before requesting review
